paid_plan.summary: Cloud: CX11 €3.49/mo (1vCPU, 2GB). Dedicated: starting at €35/mo. Storage Box: €3.49/mo

student_benefits.details: No specific student plan. Prices are already among the lowest in the market

region_restrictions.notes: Data centers in Germany, Finland, and US (Hillsboro, Ashburn). Strong GDPR compliance

resources.name: Neon
resources.description: Serverless PostgreSQL with instant provisioning, branching, and autoscaling. Separate compute and storage with pay-per-use pricing. Generous free tier ideal for side projects.

free_tier.summary: 500 MB storage, 100 compute hours/month, 1 project, 10 branches, 1 GB bandwidth/month

paid_plan.summary: Launch — $19/month: 10 GB storage, 500 compute hours, 50 branches, team features

student_benefits.details: No specific student plan, but free tier covers most student projects

region_restrictions.notes: Available globally; data regions: US (Oregon), EU (Frankfurt), APAC (Singapore)

resources.name: PlanetScale
resources.description: Serverless MySQL platform built on Vitess. Known for branching workflows, non-blocking schema changes, and generous free tier. Database branching makes schema migrations as safe as code deploys.

free_tier.summary: 1 database with 10 GB storage, 1 production branch, 3 dev branches, 1 billion row reads/month, 10 million row writes/month

paid_plan.summary: Scaler — $39/month: 100 GB storage, 10 production branches, unlimited dev branches, 100 billion reads

student_benefits.details: GitHub Student Developer Pack: free Pro tier for 1 year

region_restrictions.notes: Available globally; data regions: US, EU (Frankfurt), APAC (Tokyo)

resources.name: CockroachDB
resources.description: Distributed SQL database with PostgreSQL compatibility. Scales horizontally across regions with strong consistency and resilient auto-healing. Serverless free tier with generous limits.

free_tier.summary: 5 GB storage, 250 million Request Units/month, 1 cluster, 30 days data retention

paid_plan.summary: Standard — pay-as-you-go: $0.20/GB/month storage + $0.005/million RUs

student_benefits.details: Free serverless tier is generous; no specific student plan needed

region_restrictions.notes: Available globally; 25+ regions across US, EU, and APAC

resources.name: MongoDB Atlas
resources.description: Fully managed MongoDB on AWS, Azure, and GCP. Free M0 cluster with 512MB storage. Industry-leading document database with flexible schema, aggregation pipeline, and change streams.

free_tier.summary: M0 cluster: 512 MB storage, shared RAM, no backup, no multi-region. Deploy on AWS, Azure, or GCP

paid_plan.summary: M2 — $9/month: 2 GB storage, dedicated RAM, backups. M10 — $57/month: 10 GB, production grade

student_benefits.details: GitHub Student Developer Pack: $90 Atlas credits. MongoDB University: free courses and certification

region_restrictions.notes: Available globally across AWS, Azure, and GCP regions (70+ regions)

resources.name: Firebase Firestore
resources.description: Google's flexible, scalable NoSQL document database for mobile and web apps. Real-time sync, offline support, and deep integration with Firebase and Google Cloud ecosystem.

free_tier.summary: 1 GB stored data, 50K document reads/day, 20K writes/day, 20K deletes/day, 10 GB bandwidth/month, 1 GB network egress/day

paid_plan.summary: Blaze — Pay-as-you-go: $0.108/GB storage, $0.06/100K reads, $0.18/100K writes

student_benefits.details: Google for Education credits. Free tier is generous for student projects

region_restrictions.notes: Available in most countries; restricted in sanctioned regions

resources.name: Upstash
resources.description: Serverless Redis and Kafka platform designed for modern applications. REST API access to Redis without managing infrastructure. Ideal for caching, rate limiting, and session storage at the edge.

free_tier.summary: Redis: 10K commands/day, 50 MB storage, 1 database. Kafka: 10K messages/day, 50 MB storage

paid_plan.summary: Pay-as-you-go: Redis $0.10/GB beyond free quota. Kafka $0.50/GB messages

student_benefits.details: No specific student plan; free tier covers learning and prototyping

region_restrictions.notes: Available globally; edge locations for low-latency access

resources.name: Turso
resources.description: Edge SQLite database built on libsql. Deploy database replicas globally for instant reads with low-latency writes. Ideal for serverless and edge applications.

free_tier.summary: 500 MB storage, 1 billion row reads/month, 250M rows written/month, 25K monthly active users, 10 locations

paid_plan.summary: Team — $29/month: 8 GB storage, 10K MAU, 25 locations, team workspace

student_benefits.details: No specific student plan; free tier covers learning and prototyping

region_restrictions.notes: Available globally; edge locations in 10+ regions worldwide

resources.name: Xata
resources.description: Serverless Postgres platform with built-in full-text search, analytics, and AI vector capabilities. Declarative database branching and column-level permissions for collaborative development.

free_tier.summary: 15 GB storage, 5K records, 2 branches, built-in search and vector capabilities, REST API

paid_plan.summary: Pro — $20/month: 50 GB storage, 100K records, 10 branches, priority support

student_benefits.details: GitHub Student Developer Pack: extended credits and features

region_restrictions.notes: Available globally; data regions: US (Oregon), EU (Ireland)

resources.name: Amazon DynamoDB
resources.description: Fully managed NoSQL key-value and document database from AWS. Single-digit millisecond performance at any scale with on-demand capacity mode and ACID transactions.

free_tier.summary: 25 GB storage, 200 million requests/month, 25 WCU and 25 RCU throughput, 25 GB for streams, 1 GB DAX cache

paid_plan.summary: Pay-as-you-go: $1.25 per WCU/month, $0.25 per RCU/month. On-demand: $1.25M write req + $0.25M read req

student_benefits.details: Included in AWS Free Tier. AWS Educate: $100-500 credits for students

region_restrictions.notes: Available globally across all AWS regions (33 regions, 105+ availability zones)

resources.name: Aiven
resources.description: Managed open-source database platform supporting PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, Kafka, Cassandra, and OpenSearch. Deploy on your cloud of choice (AWS, GCP, Azure) with high availability.

free_tier.summary: PostgreSQL/MySQL: 1 GB storage, 1 node. Redis: 256 MB, 1 node. Kafka: 1 GB. All free plans have limited availability

paid_plan.summary: Startup — $39/month: 2 GB RAM, 2 nodes, 10 GB storage

student_benefits.details: No specific student plan; free tier is limited but functional
